viewport.display_scale_source: Observed physical/logical ratio on the controlled Windows host; the default 1280x800 logical fixture produces 1600x1000 physical pixels on the same host.

comparison.interpretation: This is a real public MRI-DIR eframe/egui capture with the same axial, coronal and sagittal semantic surfaces and the same 1280x800 physical host extent as the Métis native capture. The committed 640x400 manual figure is a downscaled rendering of that capture for the tracked-artifact budget; source capture dimensions and digest remain recorded. The eframe command requests 1024x640 logical points on the controlled 125% Windows host; no post-capture rescaling is used in the application. The first cold launch dominated this three-run lifecycle sample, so its uncertainty is retained. The eframe process boundary differs from the Métis process and GPUI/Tauri fixtures remain open; no framework ranking is derived.

ownership.ritk: DICOM discovery, series selection, decoding, geometry, physical placement and clinical presentation
